subject: visual-contrast
text:
- Since 2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness the stand's controls carry a measured SC 1.4.3 reading. blitz-test-harness's `Harness::text_contrast` (read-only: no mutation, input, pump or settle) takes the text-bearing element — a text input itself, else the parent element of the first non-whitespace text node under the node —, its computed `color`, `font-size` and `font-weight`, and the background behind it: each ancestor's `background-color` composited source-over down to the first opaque layer, else the root-else-`body` canvas over opaque white; it reads `None` where an element on that walk has `opacity` below 1, a non-empty `filter` or a `background-image` layer. `contrast_ratio` is the WCAG 2.x ratio over the `color` crate's relative luminance (Chrome's `GetContrastRatio`, blitz-paint's helper restated, blitz-paint untouched), and `TextContrast::required_ratio` asks 3.0 of large text (at least 24 px, or 14 pt at weight 700 or more) and 4.5 of other text. The stand check `stand_contrast` records one row per `controls(task)` row over the four lean tasks at boot (800 × 600 · scale 1 · Light · DejaVu Sans · offline), identical in both layout modes — 17 rows.
 Since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the stand's accent is one step darker, stand-wide, in every task CSS that declares it — rest `#3a5ce5`, hover `#2a4cd3`, active `#1f3fc1`, white on each 5.47 · 6.83 · 8.27; the operator's F5, a stand change and no engine change (layout-templates §Surface: desktop-native → Primary screens, its `values · desktop-native-screens` block) — and the record reads pass 13 (`back-btn` ×4, `#333333` on `#f0f0f0`, 11.09; `flight-type`, `#1a1a1a` on `#ffffff`, 17.40, 15px 400; `flight-start` 17.40; `crud-filter`, `crud-name` and `crud-surname`, `#000000` on `#ffffff`, 21.00; and the four accent controls `counter-increment`, `flight-book`, `timer-reset` and `crud-create`, each `#ffffff` on `#3a5ce5` at 5.47), fail 0, exempt-inactive 3 (`flight-return-date`, `crud-update` and `crud-delete`, exactly the rows whose snapshot `enabled` is `Some(false)`), no-text 1 (`timer-duration`, the range input); until then the accent controls read `#ffffff` on `#4a6cf7` at 4.39 against 4.5, failing. No text is large, so every threshold is 4.5; no measured colour differs from its declared value, and the painted pixel matches the measured background within 1 per channel on all 16 measured rows. Beside the record one shared reader classifies two more tables, its exempt class still exactly `enabled == Some(false)` from the snapshot and a `label[for=…]` row never exempt: `TEXT_ROWS`, 14 rows — the CRUD list rows and the text outside the controls — all pass, the lowest 9.74 (`label[for=timer-duration]`); and `STATE_ROWS`, 18 colour states reached by input — return-chosen 2 (`flight-type` and `flight-return-date`, each 17.40), start-unparseable 2, booked 1, row-selected 3, hover 5, active 5 — pass 17 and exempt 1 (`flight-book` disabled, `#ffffff` on `#a0aec0`, 2.26), the lowest pass 5.11 (`flight-start` invalid, `#c53030` on `#fff5f5`).
 `text_contrast` reads the declared `:hover` background after `move_mouse_to` and the `:active` one after `mouse_down_at`, the same in both layout modes; a button with no `:active` rule keeps its hover background while pressed, so the active rows of CRUD's buttons and `back-btn` read the hover pair. Three tests assert the three tables in both layout modes, so SC 1.4.3 is met on every measured non-exempt stand row; the check runs in the workspace `test` leg, per package and in the `a11y` leg (§9) (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:13-23; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:25-41; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:56-91; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:121-147; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:49-132; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:476-507; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:509-559; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:163-182; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:201-274; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:294-406; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:572-600; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:602-630; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_contrast.rs:632-656 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness/report.md and its evidence/pairs.md, the re-colour, the two tables and the three tests at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md and its evidence/hover-active.md)

subject: visual-contrast
text: - Since 2026-10-19-visual-lint `Harness::text_contrast` has its first non-test caller: the `contrast` reading of escher-driver's visual lint (`Session::lint` in process and the `lint` verb on every carrier, recorded; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:293-295) — a node with direct non-whitespace text or a text control, read through `text_contrast` and reported below `required_ratio()`, exempt exactly where the snapshot's `enabled` reads `Some(false)`, a `None` reading not measured — the exempt rule `stand_contrast` asserts, with no second formula or threshold; a `contrast` finding is written `id` · `defect` · `bounds` · `ratio` · `required`, ids, closed words and numbers only (packages/escher-driver/src/json.rs:280-308). The stand at boot reads no `contrast` finding on the four lean tasks in both layout modes, the nodes outside `stand_contrast`'s rows included — its one finding at boot the flight booker's `overlap` of its select's two options (below); a planted low-contrast row reads 2.8490272 against 4.5, equal to `text_contrast`'s own reading (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_lint.rs:174-314; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_lint.rs:415-442 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-visual-lint/report.md and its evidence/readings.md); the `a11y` leg reads 85 tests over 14 targets, `stand_contrast`'s 5 among them (§9; as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md)

subject: visual-contrast
text: - The driver's visual lint reads a select's options as overlapping, the snapshot giving each `ListBoxOption` its select's client rect, so the stand's flight booker at boot reads one `overlap` (`flight-type-one-way` × `flight-type-return`) in both layout modes, `stand_lint`'s `the_stand_at_boot_reads_its_measured_findings` reading `[0, 1, 0, 0]`; the defect is open, its fix a driver change for every document in the lint's overlap reading (`packages/escher-driver/src/lint.rs`, `overlaps`), owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_lint.rs:277-314 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md)

subject: visual-contrast
text: - The user-agent `select` lays out as an `inline-block` box holding its chosen option, with the `input, textarea` border (`1px solid #999`), padding (`2px`) and background (`white`) (packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:77-78; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:84-86; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:155-159); that user-agent pair is not measured; the stand's one select, `select#flight-type`, replaces it by author CSS (15px, `#1a1a1a` on `#ffffff`, `1px solid #c0c0c0`, radius 6, padding 8/10), and `stand_contrast` reads its pair at 17.40, 15px 400, against 4.5, as a control row and as a return-chosen `STATE_ROWS` row (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:160-172)

subject: visual-state-color
text: - Author styles keyed on `:open` apply to an open `details` or `dialog` in every document, `:open` reading the element's `OPEN` state (§5 Focus restoration); unasserted — no test asserts `:open` (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:510) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-27-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md

subject: visual-visibility
text: - Nodes with `display: none` or `visibility: hidden` or carrying `inert`, and their descendants, are excluded from the accessibility tree, and so from the snapshot — a select's option excepted from `display: none` (§4 Hidden content), so a select's options are its children in the tree and the snapshot; a hit answers nothing at an element carrying `inert`, before any other test, so a hit passes through it, and removing `inert` restores the tree and the hit (the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:19-28; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:254-274; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1437-1446; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:95-194); a hit also skips a node dropped since the last resolve (architecture §Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree)

subject: visual-visibility
text: - Elements with `visibility: hidden` or `collapse` are never hit-test targets (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1448-1456)

subject: visual-visibility
text: - `pointer-events: none` makes an element transparent to hits while its descendants are still tested (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1458-1462; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1662-1670)

subject: sr-tree
text: - A `select` (role `ComboBox`, `ListBox` for `multiple`) keeps its `option` children in the tree as `ListBoxOption` nodes, under `display: none` too, each `selected` true or false from its chosen state and named by its non-empty `label` attribute, else its text; the snapshot reads a `select`'s `value` as `BaseDocument::select_value` (the chosen option's value, nothing with none chosen) and its options as its children, each with its select's client rect as its `bounds`; on `stand_act_select`'s page, in both layout modes, `fx-pick` reads `ComboBox`, name `Fruit` (by its `<label>`), value `b`, its three options Apple · Banana · Cherry under it with Banana selected, and `type --id fx-pick --text Cherry` names `fx-pick` with `value` in `differs` and `fx-banana` / `fx-cherry` with `selected`; on the stand the flight booker's `select#flight-type`, named `Flight type` by `aria-label`, reads `ComboBox` with value `one-way` and its two options `flight-type-one-way` and `flight-type-return` as `ListBoxOption` children named `one-way flight` and `return flight`, exactly the chosen one selected (`stand_snapshot::the_flight_type_select_holds_its_two_options`, `stand_snapshot_state::exactly_the_chosen_flight_type_reads_selected`) (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:66-89; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot.rs:118-170; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:157-162; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:171-181; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:717-728; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:144-152; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:241-250; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:253-259; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:79-132; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_select.rs:134-167) — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-select-by-id/report.md

subject: sr-author-id
text:
- In a Dioxus document every element node carries its stable element id as AccessKit `author_id`, and no `TextRun`, document-root or `Window` node carries one; on the stand the 14 interactive controls carry an HTML-AAM role and a non-empty accessible name — the six inputs named by four `<label for>` and two `aria-label` attributes, the flight booker's `select#flight-type` (`ComboBox`) by `aria-label` `Flight type` — in both layout modes, with the Tab order unchanged at that chunk — CRUD's restated at 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness to six stops, `crud-list` third (§8) — (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:294-310; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:1-4) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-accessibility-tree-identity/report.md; since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states an element outside those controls carries an interactive role by attribute — the CRUD list reads `ListBox`, its rows `ListBoxOption` (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:58; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:96-97 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md) — and until 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the list read the accessible name `""`; since then it is named `People` by `aria-label` (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:59), every interactive-role tree node of the four lean tasks reads a non-empty name — asserted in both layout modes over the nine roles of `INTERACTIVE_ROLES`, Button, TextInput, Slider, ListBox, ListBoxOption, CheckBox, RadioButton, ComboBox and Link, each task's count at least its `controls` rows and each `REGION_NAMES` row's name in the tree and the snapshot
 — and the tree the shell hands the adapter, `Document::accessibility_tree` through `&dyn blitz_dom::Document` (the call `AccessibilityState::update_tree` makes), equals `harness.doc.accessibility_tree()` by id, node for node, with the same focus and root, every `author_id` on it the node's `element_id`, none empty, all digits or holding `0x` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:26-37; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:39-43; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:255-308; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:310-352 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md); the roles, input names and region names those checks expect are stated once, as the tables `controls`, `INPUT_NAMES` and, since that chunk, `REGION_NAMES` of the stand checks' shared module, beside `rendered`, the ids rendered per task — stated expectation, never a second role or name mapping (tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:17-123; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:125-128; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:132-168) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-audit-corrections/report.md

subject: sr-snapshot
text:
- The snapshot model is a consumer of this output: under dioxus-native-dom's `accessibility` feature `DioxusDocument::snapshot` takes each node's role, its name (the `label`, else the names of its `labelled_by` targets — since 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts the `label` is also the computed text of an element's `aria-labelledby` targets, which outranks a `<label>` and an `aria-label` (§2 Role derivation), so that text reaches the snapshot `name`) and the focused node from the tree `accessibility_tree` returns, with no second role or name mapping; on the stand every snapshot node's role and name equal its accessibility node's, nothing reads focused at boot, and after one focus move only `back-btn` does, in both layout modes (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:96-115; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:199-217; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot.rs:1-5) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-model/report.md; since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states the tree gives an element node `selected`, `toggled` and `invalid` (§2 Role derivation), and the snapshot takes those three from the tree, never from the element — `NodeState.selected` and `.pressed` (read off the five checkable roles), each an `Option<bool>`, and `.invalid`, a `bool`, the model's seven fields in the order `enabled` · `checked` · `value` · `selected` · `pressed` · `invalid` · `focused`, with the two limits of the boolean model: a mixed toggle reads `pressed` false and a grammar or spelling error reads invalid, the node keeping the full value; `Snapshot::to_text` writes `selected` / `unselected`, `pressed` / `unpressed` and `invalid` after `value=` and before `focused`, `Snapshot::diff` names a node whose one such reading moved, and on the stand each reading is asserted equal to its accessibility node's in both layout modes
 — exactly the chosen flight type's option reads selected, exactly the selected row reads selected, a date that is no date reads invalid, the stand stating no `aria-pressed` and `pressed` pinned on a fixture by `accessibility_states` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:63-74; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:177-182; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_text.rs:112-124; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:60-87; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:367-407; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:409-459; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:461-496) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md; the tree gives an element node no value property and a checked one only as `toggled` on a checkable role, and a disabled one only from `aria-disabled` `true` since 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts, so the snapshot reads those three from the element — never the tree's disabled, so `aria-disabled` moves no snapshot reading (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:51-52; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:166) — `enabled` follows the presence of `disabled` on an element that can be disabled (a `disabled="false"` and a bare `disabled` read not enabled and, since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, are not focusable either — the restated `stand_snapshot_state` parsed-markup pin and the snapshot unit pin `a_present_disabled_attribute_reads_not_enabled_and_not_focusable_whatever_its_value` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:616-617), §5 Focus order; the driver's `disabled` refusal cause is stated on this same presence reading — its meaning reads "the element carries the `disabled` attribute, which the snapshot reads as not enabled"
 — and since 2026-10-07-refusal-detection the driver detects it on that reading and no other: `Session::run` refuses a `click` or a `type` as `disabled` when the snapshot node's `enabled` is `Some(false)`, the first of its three screen-level checks, with nothing dispatched and the ids reading `focused` and the tree's focus as they were before the call; on the stand `crud-delete` and `flight-return-date` are refused while they read not enabled and acted on once they read enabled, in both layout modes (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:427-445; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_disabled.rs:1-8); the driver's schema defines no role or name set of its own, `role` and `name` being field names of its result nodes — the schema as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-command-and-refusal-schema/report.md, the detection at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-refusal-detection/report.md), `checked` is a native checkbox's or radio's state, else, on a checkable role, its `toggled` reading — `True` true, `False` and `Mixed` false, nothing where the role states none — and the node keys' help that `help` serves states that source and its mixed-reads-false (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:169-181; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:219-231; packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs:77-80; packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs:96-97), `value` is the editor's text, else — for a range input, since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction — its current value (`ElementData::range_input_value`, the formatted value a key or a pointerdown moved, while its `value` attribute keeps the boot value; the driver's diff names `timer-duration` with `differs` `value` on a step; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:252-255; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:275-277;
 packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:660-704 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-range-input-interaction/report.md), else the `value` attribute — a textarea's as a text input's: on the in-file fixture of `stand_snapshot_state` a textarea named by `aria-label` reads role `MultilineTextInput`, a non-empty name, its HTML `id` as its stable id and a box wider and taller than 0, reads `""` untyped and its typed text back as its `value`, unmasked, and after the click exactly it reads `focused` and is the tree's focus, in both layout modes; it is a test-only element of that fixture, and no stand task or app gained one with it (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:524-531; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:698-725) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-09-audit-corrections-agent-surfaces/report.md —, and a password input reads the fixed marker `MASKED_VALUE` where it holds text and `""` where it holds none, its typed text in no field of the snapshot or of the tree — and, since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, in no painted frame either: blitz-paint paints a password input's value as bullets, laid out with the input's editor styles, scale and direction in the document's own fonts (`BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input`), in every document and through every renderer that paints with blitz-paint, windowed included (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-12, «Движок маскирует», relayed verbatim by the overseer); two values of one length paint byte-identical frames, focused or not, in both layout modes, the snapshot still reads `MASKED_VALUE` and the tree is unchanged; a click inside a field holding a value places the caret by the bullets
 — `click_password_input` lays out one U+2022 per character through `BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input`, scrolls it as paint does, finds the bullet under the point and moves the real editor to that character (a shift-click extends, two or more clicks select all), so no width of the real characters reaches the caret: two values of one length read one index, inside 1–7, in both layout modes (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:582-648; tests/blitz-tests/tests/password_caret_click.rs:83-121); the windowed paint is not run here (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:912-916; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:975-1049; tests/blitz-tests/tests/password_painted_masked.rs:95-104; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_screenshot.rs:254-267 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md) —, and a file input reads the same marker where its `value` attribute is non-empty, its path in no field of the snapshot; and focus is proven three ways on the stand in both layout modes — after a pointer click, a Tab press and Shift+Tab exactly the focused control's node reads `focused` and it is the tree's focus (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:165-184; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:256-283; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:1-11) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-state-fidelity/report.md, the file-input reading at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-compact-snapshot-serialization/report.md; the snapshot's text form `Snapshot::to_text` is a further reader of that model, never of the tree or of a control
 — each line's role and name are the snapshot node's, with no second role or name mapping, there is one line per snapshot node, and on the stand no line reads `focused` at boot and exactly `back-btn`'s does after a Tab press, in both layout modes (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_text.rs:53; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_text.rs:1-7) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-compact-snapshot-serialization/report.md; the snapshot's diff `Snapshot::diff` is one more reader of that model and of nothing else — a comparison of two snapshots by stable element id, its entries carrying the role and name the later snapshot holds, with no second role or name mapping — so on the stand, in both layout modes, a text change is reported on the element whose accessible name it changes, by that element's id and never as a text-run entry (`counter-value` after a click, the labelled input after its label is rewritten), an element hidden and shown by its `hidden` attribute leaves and returns with its descendants, and a pointer click, a Tab press and Shift+Tab each name exactly the controls whose `focused` reading moved (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_diff.rs:108; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_diff.rs:1-12) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-change-tracking-and-diff/report.md; the text's parts (`Snapshot::text_parts`, `TextPart`) are one more reader of that model through the text form and of nothing else — consecutive pre-order lines of `to_text`, never a split line, the parts concatenating to the whole text with every node id on exactly one line
 — and the driver's `snapshot` reads a screen over `SNAPSHOT_TEXT_BUDGET` in parts: on an over-budget fixture, in both layout modes, each part's lines equal their lines in the whole text, a password's line reads `MASKED_VALUE` in every part, and exactly one line reads `focused` after a click (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_text.rs:59-81; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_parts.rs:59-181) — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-20-large-screen-in-parts/report.md; since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface an MCP tool result is a further reader of that model and of nothing else — an accepted `snapshot` result is `to_text`'s output itself for a whole screen and, for a screen read in parts, its JSON line `{"text","part","parts"}` holding that part's text — through `serve_mcp` a walk's text blocks equal the JSON lines `Session::run` writes, in both layout modes (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_parts.rs:220-281) — and an acting call's result its JSON line with the diff, with no second role or name mapping: on the stand a `snapshot` text block equals `Session::run`'s screen text byte for byte, in both layout modes (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp/result.rs:29-104; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_mcp_tools.rs:225-397) — its crossing to an MCP client ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, «Ратифицировать как есть», relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's), as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md; since 2026-10-12-self-description a password input typed through an MCP `type` reads `MASKED_VALUE` in the tool result, role `PasswordInput` and a non-empty name, the typed sentinel 0 times in both results, in both layout modes
 — the input a test-only element of the shared password page `fixtures::password_named`, no stand task or app gaining one with it (tests/blitz-tests/tests/fixtures/mod.rs:37-44; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_mcp_masked.rs:67-143); and since that chunk two further readers of the same model, closed words only: the node keys' help, which `help` serves — each key's reading stated by the tool, the boolean model's two limits among them (a mixed toggle reads `pressed` false, a grammar or spelling error reads `invalid` true) — and `DiffNode::differs`, a changed node naming the readings that differ from before the step in node-key order, the Flight Booker's Book naming eight nodes, in both layout modes — seven that only moved, `differs` = `[bounds]`, and since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness `flight-book` itself, which the click now focuses, `differs` = `[focused, bounds]` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_diff.rs:174-209; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_diff.rs:488-530; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_diff.rs:522-525) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-self-description/report.md and, for `flight-book`, as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot the driver's `screenshot` is one more reader of the model's bounds and of nothing else in it — an element shot, addressed by stable id and refused as every id-addressed call is, is the node's bounds rounded outward and cropped to the part that can be seen — and a shot changes nothing: no focus moves, `has_changes` stays false and the next diff is empty, in both layout modes (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:460-481; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_screenshot.rs:125-150; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_screenshot.rs:269-302) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md

subject: sr-actionable-keys
text: - The check also returns nothing on the load page the stand serves beside the lean four (`stand_load_page::the_load_page_is_keyed_and_reads_no_finding_at_boot`, in both layout modes), so it reads empty on all six tasks `escher-session` serves; the page holds two elements, `load-fetch`, a Button named `Load`, and `load-done`, a Paragraph `Loaded` at `display: none` until its stylesheet lands, out of the tree and the snapshot while it is hidden, and no Tab-order, keyboard-activation or contrast row (§5) (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:185-200; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_load_page.rs:34-84)

subject: sr-stand-states
text: - On the stand two kinds of control state a role or a state by attribute alone since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states, with no element, class, style, key, id or order moving: the CRUD list states `role="listbox"` and each person row `role="option"` with `aria-selected`, reading `ListBox` / `ListBoxOption` in the tree, and the flight booker's two date inputs state `aria-invalid`; the stand states no `aria-pressed` — the flight booker's mode is one `select#flight-type`, whose options `flight-type-one-way` and `flight-type-return` state the choice by `selected`, `aria-pressed` pinned on a fixture by `accessibility_states`; the actionable-key check still returns nothing; one gap stands open — the rows are not focusable and the tree's focus is the list, never the option: since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness the focused list's keys move the selection (§5 Per-surface keyboard shortcuts), and the missing `aria-activedescendant` is kept unread on the founder's F2 «Оставить записанным (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-14), pinned by `accessibility_active_descendant_unread` (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_active_descendant_unread.rs:39-81) — the second, the list's empty accessible name, closed at 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions, the list named `People` by `aria-label` (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:59) (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:58; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:96-97; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:66-89; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:93; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:101; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:367-407; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:409-459; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:461-496) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md, the flight type's select at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md

subject: cognitive-error-recovery
text: - Invalid dates get an `invalid` class with red styling and the Book button disables (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:90-110; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:194-198); since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states the two date inputs `flight-start` and `flight-return-date` also state `aria-invalid`, so the invalid state is in the accessibility tree and the snapshot and not carried by the class alone, the class and its styling staying (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:93; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/flight_booker.rs:101; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:461-496 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md); the headless-stand check asserts the cue without colour — a typed non-date sets `invalid` on the start field and gives `.flight-btn` a `disabled` attribute it did not carry before (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_flight_booker.rs:14-30); the stand asserts each lean task's forward focus sequence through `focus_next_node` against the shared table `tab_order` — moved into the stand checks' shared module since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, CRUD's sequence restated there to six stops, `back-btn`, `crud-filter`, `crud-list`, `crud-name`, `crud-surname`, `crud-create`, and the flight booker's to four, `back-btn`, `flight-type`, `flight-start`, `flight-book` (`flight-return-date` joining in `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, five stops), the error-recovery cue unchanged (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:95-110; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:236-253; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:47-63) and, in the snapshot check, that only `back-btn` reads `focused` after one such move (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot.rs:262-315)

subject: ci
text:
ci.yml's `a11y` job, "Accessibility (a11y) tests", runs `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh a11y` — from 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions until the fourteen below `cargo test --workspace --locked --test accessibility_hidden --test accessibility_roles --test focusability_updates --test stand_keyboard --test stand_contrast --test stand_accessibility_ids`, its log accessibility_hidden 6 · accessibility_roles 6 · focusability_updates 4 · stand_accessibility_ids 8 · stand_contrast 5 · stand_keyboard 14, the first three files alone until then (`focusability_updates` 3 until 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness added `a_bare_disabled_set_after_creation_takes_the_focusability_away`) — widened on the founder's F4 «Расширить задание a11y (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-14, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed by the overseer as his chosen option label), with no new job, no required status check and no repository setting; the job itself is unchanged, in the slow tier behind the four fast jobs, restoring the test job's cache and saving none (.github/workflows/ci.yml:247-268; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:39; its pin, `LegScriptTest`'s a11y tuple, .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:298-302); since that chunk it runs the stand's keyboard, contrast and accessibility-id assertions, and the pushed sha's CI#38527662148 read green, 16/16, with "Accessibility (a11y) tests" among the checks — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md. Since 2026-10-14-quality-gates `stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast` and `stand_accessibility_ids`, as `stand_*` files, also run three times in the `stand-repeat` leg and its job `Stand checks repeated`, which restores the test job's cache and saves none, under the zero-failure budget (test-plan §10); the a11y leg and job were then unchanged, their per-file counts as above (.github/workflows/ci.yml:300-323; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:48-65).
 Three a11y witnesses outside the `stand_` prefix — `accessibility_states`, `inert_subtree` and `accessibility_active_descendant_unread` — also run three rounds in `stand-repeat`, by the leg's fixed `--test` list after its `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_*.rs` glob on the same `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked` line, each keeping its name, the list's ten words pinned by `test_stand_repeat_leg_runs_three_rounds` and their names also read by `stand_requirement_sweep`'s leg check, which reads `ci-leg.sh` as one whole text by `contains` and so cannot see one dropped from the stand-repeat list alone while the a11y leg still names it — only both sites removed read red — so the list's membership is held by the two checks jointly (as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-26-codebase-health/report.md) (test-plan §1); the a11y leg's six files and its job were then unchanged, CI#40114977936 reading the a11y job 6 · 43 (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:54-58; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:362-365 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md).
 The leg now runs fourteen `--test` targets, still one `cargo test --workspace --locked` line with no comment line: the six, in their order, then `accessibility_states`, `accessibility_label`, `accessibility_description`, `accessibility_merged_states`, `accessibility_active_descendant_unread`, `inert_subtree`, `select_interaction` and `stand_act_select` — the founder's «Плюс проверки дерева (Рекомендую)»: the five tree-reading checks beside the three tier-0 witnesses, 14 files and 85 tests (`stand_keyboard` 15), over the tier-0 witnesses alone, 9 files and 59 tests, the leg already running the non-tier-0 `accessibility_hidden` and `accessibility_roles`; `focus_redraw`, `focus_within` and `accessibility_names` left out, run in the workspace `test` leg and per package. Each joining file witnesses an SC 2.1.1 or 2.4.3 requirement, a tree reading the founder took, or a recorded gap (`accessibility_active_descendant_unread`, the pinned unread `aria-activedescendant`), and keeps every leg it already ran in — the workspace `test` leg and per package for all eight, three `stand-repeat` rounds for `accessibility_states`, `inert_subtree`, `accessibility_active_descendant_unread` and `select_interaction` by its named `--test` list and for `stand_act_select` by its `stand_*` glob — so `stand_act_select` runs in both the `a11y` and `stand-repeat` legs, as `stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast` and `stand_accessibility_ids` do.
 Its log reads the six unmoved (43) and accessibility_states 5 · accessibility_label 13 · accessibility_description 3 · accessibility_merged_states 3 · accessibility_active_descendant_unread 1 · inert_subtree 4 · select_interaction 7 · stand_act_select 5 (41): 14 result lines · 84 passed · 0 failed · 0 ignored, locally and on the "Accessibility (a11y) tests" job of CI#40134371519 (6 · 43 on CI#40125511019), every other job's tally unmoved; the job keeps its slow tier, its `needs`, its restore-only `workspace-test` cache, its failure-only log upload and no required status check. Its pin, `LegScriptTest`'s a11y tuple, asserts each of the fourteen target words, beside `--workspace` and `--locked`, by one `assertIn` over the shimmed log, in no order (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:39; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:54-58; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:298-302 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-a11y-re-read/report.md and its evidence/counts.md, evidence/ci.md).
 The stand's Tab order, Enter and Space activation and contrast hold after 0.2.0's engine changes: `stand_keyboard` 14, `stand_contrast` 5 and `stand_accessibility_ids` 8 green in the leg, per package and in each `stand-repeat` round, `tab_order`, `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, `controls`, `TEXT_ROWS` and `STATE_ROWS` unedited and nothing re-baselined, each 0.2.0 engine change named with its witness, by test function — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-a11y-re-read/evidence/re-read.md; the stand's tables are re-pinned to the flight booker's `select#flight-type` — `tab_order`, `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` and `controls` (14 controls, 17 rows) carrying it as `Role::ComboBox`, `stand_keyboard`'s activation table 16 rows, `stand_contrast`'s control rows 17 and `STATE_ROWS` 18, `TEXT_ROWS` 14 — a stand change, no engine crate moving, green in the leg and in three `stand-repeat` rounds (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md); `accessibility_merged_states` reads `aria-expanded` · `aria-disabled` · `aria-level`, not `aria-checked`, which `accessibility_states` asserts.
